notes: All 12 views inspected. Shoulder pauldron with a domed cap, a brass spiral ornament, four overlapping lames with brass edges and rivets, a dark inner lining and two leather straps with brass buckles. The top and bottom views confirm a hollow shell with real wall thickness and an open armhole, so it can be fitted over a shoulder. Free-standing, no stand. Unrigged.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The lames are fused and will not articulate independently.
Modelled for one shoulder; mirror it for the other.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
